annotations.title: Design a social post or ad

description: Make a social media post or ad in the member's Creadal account from a professionally designed ready template: headline, supporting line, offer, call-to-action button, brand and website filled in, the member's own picture (a product photo or an app or website screenshot, given as a public https link) placed in the template's picture frame, and their logo (a public https link, PNG with transparency is best) in place of the brand name. Returns a preview picture and a link to open and edit it in the Creadal editor. Use this, not generate_presentation, for posts, stories and ads. Optionally makes the picture with AI instead (uses one AI image from the member's plan).

brand_name.description: The brand, shown where the template has its brand name (and under the logo when there is no logo).

description.description: What is advertised and for whom, in a sentence: helps pick the best template.

format.description: square 1080x1080 (default), portrait 1080x1350, story 1080x1920, landscape 1200x628 (link ads), wide 1280x720.

headline.description: The main line, short (2 to 6 words reads best).

image_fit.description: cover fills the frame (photos, default); contain shows the whole picture (screenshots).

image_prompt.description: Optional: describe a picture to make with AI when there is no image_url (uses one AI image from the plan).

image_url.description: Optional: a public https link to the picture to show (product photo or screenshot).

kicker.description: A small line above the headline, e.g. 'New' or the product category.

language.description: Language of the template texts left as they are: en (default) or tr.

logo_url.description: Optional: a public https link to the logo (PNG with transparency is best).

offer.description: An offer, price or detail line, e.g. 'Free for 14 days'.

subheadline.description: A supporting line under the headline.

template_id.description: Optional: a template id to use instead of the best match.

name: create_social_design
title: Design a social post or ad
